test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 26 July 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: A shopkeeper sold 24 shirts, each at a profit of 20% and 16 shirts, each at a profit of 10%. If he had sold all the 40 shirts, each at a profit of 15%, then his overall profit would have been reduced by Rs. 36. What is the cost price of each shirt?
solution:
**Given:**

A shopkeeper sold 24 shirts, each at a profit of 20% 

16 shirts, each at a profit of 10%.

**Concept used:**

SP = CP(1 + P%)

**Calculation:**

Let the cost price of each shirt be Rs 100

Selling price of each shirt at 20% profit = 100(120/100) = Rs. 120

Sale amount of 24 shirts = 120 &a
